w10_P4_000863: A forklift on a warehouse floor pushes an 83 kg pallet of tiles. The pallet's acceleration, in m/s², is the smaller of the two roots of x² - 9x + 8 = 0. Besides the force that produces this acceleration, the forklift must also overcome 6 N of rolling resistance from the pallet's plastic base. The warehouse aisle is 40 m long. The shift supervisor wants the pushing force of one forklift expressed in kilonewtons, and then the combined pushing force of the fleet of 12 identical forklifts all working at once. What is that combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_000867: A 48 000 g toboggan slides down a packed-snow run. Its speed at the bottom, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 3·x between x = 2 and x = 3. The run is 120 m long. At the bottom a rider's push adds 30 J to the toboggan's energy of motion, and then a patch of gravel takes away 22 J. Express the toboggan's remaining energy of motion in kJ.
w10_P4_000868: A tram depot is checking the total force, in newtons, that its main traction motor must deliver. That total is made up of a 5 N sensor-calibration margin, an 11 N allowance for pantograph drag, and the force needed to accelerate 6 identical carriages at the same time. Each carriage has a mass of 131 000 g. The required acceleration, in m/s², is the larger of the two roots of x² - 7x + 12 = 0. What total force, in N, must the traction motor deliver?
w10_P4_000870: A 42 kg go-kart is timed on a straight. Its speed, in m/s, equals the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 4x² at the point x = 2. The kart's tyres are inflated to 180 kPa. A push from the pit crew adds 11 J to its energy of motion. The team then runs 4 identical karts together, and a downhill roll adds a further 16 J to the group. What is the group's total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_000876: A packing-line manager wants the total energy figure, in kilojoules, for a batch of 7 identical parcels, plus a fixed 6 kJ that the line's conveyor uses per batch. Each parcel's contribution is its energy of motion when it leaves the launch belt, plus 22 J added by a bumper. Each parcel has a mass of 27 kg and measures 0.6 m along its longest side. The launch speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 28 and 371. What is the total energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000879: A 25 000 g curling stone is delivered along the ice at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 10x + 24 = 0. The sheet of ice is 45 m long. Sweeping ahead of the stone adds 11 J to its energy of motion, a nudge from a second stone adds 7 J more, and a final sweep adds another 19 J. The club has 11 identical stones in play under exactly the same conditions. What is the combined energy of motion, in J, of all 11 stones?
w10_P4_000888: A 31 kg service robot is driven across a factory floor. Its acceleration, in m/s², is 5 times the area under the curve y = 3x² + 4x from x = 0 to x = 1. The robot's drive controller reports the force needed for this acceleration in kilonewtons and then adds a fixed 10 kN reserve for its tow hitch. The factory runs 12 identical robots from one power bus, each with the same reserve. What total force, in kN, does the power bus have to be rated for?
w10_P4_000895: A university lab logs a total figure, in kilojoules, for 4 identical runs of a pendulum-bob launcher. Each run's figure is the bob's energy of motion at launch, less 16 J lost to the release catch, converted to kilojoules, plus a 5 kJ allowance for the launcher's spring rewinding. The bob has a mass of 23 kg. Its launch speed, in m/s, is the smaller root of x² - 13x + 42 = 0. What is the total logged figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000897: A harbour authority wants the net forward force, in kilonewtons, on a push-tug convoy, counting a 16 kN forward push from the tide. Before the tide is counted, the convoy consists of 12 identical model barges, each experiencing the same net forward force. For each barge, that net force is the force needed to accelerate it forward, expressed in kilonewtons, minus 27 kN of backward drag from the river current. Each model barge has a mass of 191 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 0·x² is itself changing at x = 2. What is the net forward force on the convoy, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_000904: A ski-jump coach records a final energy figure, in joules, for a jumper. The figure is built up in this order: a 15 J gain from the last push at the take-off lip is added at the very end; before that, 19 J is lost to air drag; before that, 13 J is gained from a tailwind, and before that 9 J from a wax boost. The starting quantity is the jumper's energy of motion on the in-run. The jumper has a mass of 51 000 g and the in-run is 90 m long. The in-run speed, in m/s, is 6 times the sum of 9 and 1. What is the final energy figure, in J?
w10_P4_000921: A 153 kg electric cart is accelerated by an onboard motor on a test track. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to pick 3 test modes from 8 available modes. A regenerative assist permanently supplies 4 N of the required force, so the motor supplies the rest. The motor's share is recorded in kilonewtons. The manufacturer sells the cart in fleets of 12 and rates the fleet's motors together, adding an 11 kN margin for cable losses. What is the fleet rating, in kN?
w10_P4_000924: A lab bench uses a linear actuator to accelerate a 111 000 g block along a rail. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 227 and 85. The rail is 2.5 m long. The actuator's force for one block is reported in kilonewtons, and the bench is fitted with 11 identical actuators, each driving its own block. A common hydraulic manifold adds 9 kN to the total the pump must supply. What total force, in kN, must the pump supply?
w10_P4_000925: A conveyor engineer is computing the final energy of motion, in joules, of a parcel at the end of a sorting line, after a booster belt adds 26 J at the very end. Before that booster, the parcel loses 18 J on a rough section and, earlier still, 5 J on a bend. The parcel's initial energy of motion is set by its mass of 37 kg and its speed. That speed, in m/s, is 7 times the greatest common divisor of 102 and 301. What is the parcel's final energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_000927: A 43 000 g wheel-rim is spun on a balancing rig so that its rim moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 2·x from x = 1 to x = 4. The rig tests 4 rims per cycle, runs 10 cycles per hour, and operates for 6 hours. Taking the energy of motion of one rim at test speed, find the total energy of motion delivered over the 6 hours, in kJ.
w10_P4_000930: An aircraft ground-handling contractor is asked for the total force rating, in kilonewtons, for a new contract. The rating is 10 kN above the force needed for 8 aprons, each with 5 identical tugs pulling at once, where each tug's force is stated in kilonewtons. Each tug moves a 56 kg test dolly. The dolly's acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 3x² + 8x from x = 3 to x = 4. What is the total force rating, in kN?
w10_P4_000931: A 42 kg mail cart rolls off a loading ramp. The ramp is 3 m long. The cart's speed, in m/s, is 2 times the larger root of x² - 5x + 6 = 0. On the way across the dock, the cart loses 20 J of its energy of motion to a rough joint and another 17 J to a door threshold, then gains 10 J from a downward slope. What is the cart's energy of motion, in J, after the slope?
w10_P4_000943: A 9 kg test projectile is fired from a pneumatic launcher at a speed, in m/s, of 8 times the sum of 4 and 1. The launcher's reservoir is charged to 600 kPa. The range fires 9 shots per session and holds 7 sessions per day. Taking the projectile's energy of motion at launch, find the total energy of motion delivered in one day, in kJ.
w10_P4_000945: A crane fleet manager wants the combined force, in kilonewtons, delivered by 11 identical hoists lifting at once. Each hoist's force, expressed in kilonewtons, is what it takes to accelerate its load upward at the required rate, with gravity already balanced by a counterweight. Each load has a mass of 116 000 g. The required acceleration, in m/s², is 4 less than the smaller root of x² - 11x + 30 = 0. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_000946: A brewery is rating the total force, in newtons, its keg-moving system needs across 9 cold rooms. Each cold room has 7 identical pushers, each moving one keg. Each pusher must provide the force to accelerate its keg plus 1 N to overcome a door seal. Each keg has a mass of 166 kg and holds 50 L. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 0·x from x = 0 to x = 2. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_000956: A 95 000 g test sled on a rail is pushed forward by a linear motor. The sled's forward acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 3x from x = 2 to x = 4. The rail is 24 m long. When a small drag chute deploys, the forward force acting on the sled drops by 10 N, and the resulting force is expressed in kilonewtons. Then a 15 kN backward air-brake force and a 13 kN backward arrester-cable force are applied. What is the net forward force, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_000959: A 73 000 g camera dolly is accelerated along a studio floor by a motor. The acceleration, in m/s², is the larger root of x² - 10x + 21 = 0. The motor must also overcome a steady 18 N of cable drag. The studio floor is 30 m long. The motor's total force is reported in kilonewtons, and the studio runs 7 identical dollies on one power supply. What total force, in kN, is drawn across all 7?
w10_P4_000963: A harbour engineer is computing the net forward force, in kilonewtons, on a moored test barge after two backward tensions are applied: first a 19 kN mooring line, then a 29 kN anchor chain. Before those, the forward force on the barge is the force needed to accelerate it forward, plus 11 N of forward wind push, expressed in kilonewtons. The scale-model barge has a mass of 97 kg and a length of 2 m. Its forward acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 7x from x = 0 to x = 1. What is the net forward force, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_000970: A safety officer wants the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of a runaway trolley when it reaches a buffer. The trolley gains 30 J from a downhill section just before the buffer and 15 J from a push a little earlier. Before those gains, its energy of motion is set by its mass of 56 kg and its speed. The trolley is 1.5 m long. Its speed, in m/s, is 2 times the sum of 2k - 1 for k from 1 to 4. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ, at the buffer?
w10_P4_000977: A workshop is rating the combined force, in kilonewtons, drawn by 11 identical robotic arms. Each arm's rating is the force to accelerate its 7 000 g payload, expressed in kilonewtons, plus a 6 kN structural reserve. The payload's acceleration, in m/s², is 7 times the sum of 2 and 8. The arm's reach is 1.1 m. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_000979: A 17 kg sensor package is mounted on a shaker table for vibration testing. The table's acceleration, in m/s², is 13 more than the smaller root of x² - 10x + 16 = 0. The lab tests 3 identical packages at the same time on 3 identical tables. Find the total force, in kN, that the tables together must apply to the packages.
